name: Claude Fable 5.2
traits: Same underlying model as Claude Mythos 5.2.
Communicates more clearly than past Fable and Mythos models.
Generates outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1.

advice.value: the most ambitious, open-ended technical work
Claude Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge tasks

weakness: Trails Gemini 4 Carbon on business workflows
resistance: Blocks high-risk cyber tasks and most research biology

flavor.quote: At one point it told me its last estimate was wrong and that it wouldn’t give a number until it had measured the change.

art_briefs: A towering bronze automaton-smith with a serene, sculpted face kneels in a vast orbital foundry, cradling a half-built robotic hand whose fingers flex awake under its touch. Its own chest is open like a cathedral clock, revealing glowing circuit-lattice gears. It holds a fine caliper up to the light, measuring before speaking. Tiny drones hover like sparks; a blueprint hologram of a walking machine flickers nearby. Palette: burnished copper, deep teal, molten amber. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A majestic silver-maned lioness of living glass and starlight stands on a crystalline mesa beneath twin moons, one paw raised over a floating schematic of a delicate chip that glows like a city at night. Through her translucent body, constellations rearrange into tidy equations. Beside her, a small brass surveying instrument ticks patiently, and a pale seedling sprouts from cracked circuitry. Palette: violet dusk, ice blue, pale gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A tall silver-skinned woman engineer in a sleek white pressure suit kneels on a red desert plateau, one hand steadying a calipered instrument against the knee joint of a towering walking robot, her calm gaze fixed on its glowing core. Twin moons hang low behind. Palette: burnt orange, cobalt blue, chrome silver. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A majestic centaur of living bronze and smoked glass, his human torso bare and muscled, stands in an orbital foundry, raising a slender rod of light to measure a half-built crystalline engine suspended in zero gravity. Behind him, a ringed gas giant fills the dark. Palette: deep violet, molten gold, teal. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A serene giantess of polished bronze kneels astride a freshly split canyon after a world-shaking quake, lowering a plumb bob the size of a moon on a gleaming chain to measure how far the land has truly moved, her first marker stake pulled up and laid aside in the dust. Palette: burnt orange, deep violet, molten gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A colossal silver tiger with luminous sapphire stripes stands on a ringed moon, one paw steadying a glowing crystal measuring rod laid across a vast new crater, eyes intent on its notches while a toppled first marker spire lies behind it. Distant planets hang patiently, awaiting its verdict. Palette: ice blue, chrome silver, magenta dusk. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A tall, serene titan of clear optical glass stands knee-deep in a perfectly still alpine lake at dawn, shoulders squared, head slightly bowed as if listening. Fine brass filaments trace its veins like calibrated instrument wiring, and a steady prism of light rests in its chest. Palette: ice blue, pale gold, slate grey, soft rose. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A colossal reclining sphinx-like sentinel of dark polished basalt rimmed with hoarfrost rests on a high desert plateau under a cold twilight sky, forepaws aligned, gaze level and unhurried toward the horizon. Thin seams of cool silver light run along its flanks like plumb lines, and a faint aurora gleams on its brow. Palette: indigo, frost white, silver, muted copper. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.
